checks.note: All seven segments exist in all three narrated languages and the longest narration is 33.92 s (zh-Hans segment 6), under the 35 s ceiling; the fact's per-language table has no segment over it. The chapter lists in the screenshots agree: guide-en-desktop.png reads 0:12 to 0:28 for a 2:36 total, guide-es-desktop.png 0:16 to 0:34 for 3:04, guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png 0:15 to 0:36 for 3:11. The zh-Hans chapter 6 running time of 36.32 s is the title card and pauses on top of 33.92 s of narration, which the rubric counts separately.

The no_owl fact searched 18 files and returned no matches. Nothing in any screenshot shows an owl or a mascot: the four panels in guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png are drawings of a head and ear - the mastoid dressing, a hand pulling the head wrap off with a direction arrow, the shaved area with the incision behind the ear, and a magnified ear with the tape strips.

The narrator fact lists one voice, George, for each of en, es and zh-Hans, so one narrator speaks in every language offered and no character speaks. The screenshots match: the transcript in all three languages speaks to the patient in the second person ('Two days after surgery, remove the mastoid dressing', 'Dos dias despues de la cirugia, quitese el vendaje mastoideo') with no character name or speech bubble anywhere.

The subtitles fact shows captions for segments 1-7 in en, es and zh-Hans. At 1280x800 the caption bar under the video carries the line in the page's language and the transcript highlights the spoken sentence (guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png, guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png, each with a Captions/Subtitulos/字幕 checkbox on). At 375x812 the transcript is the caption track and the spoken word is highlighted - 'after', 'despues', '天后' in guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png, guide-zh-Hans-phone.png - which is the layout the rubric says was chosen on purpose. Text is readable and not clipped at either width. One thing to watch, not a failure: the desktop caption bar breaks by width, so paused it can read 'Two days after surgery, remove the mastoid' with 'dressing' in the next chunk (guide-en-desktop.png), and the Mandarin word highlight takes in the comma ('天后，' in guide-zh-Hans-phone.png).

The toc fact lists 7 chapters, and every chapter seek landed exactly on its expected start (0, 12.4, 37.44, 61.92, 77.68, 101.28, 129.36 s) with the matching chapter going active. At 1280x800 all seven are listed down the left with their times in every language (guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png, guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png). At 375x812 the list becomes a chapter control on the first screen - 'CHAPTER 1 OF 7' with back, forward and a dropdown (guide-en-phone.png, and the same in Spanish and Mandarin) - so a patient can still reach any chapter, though on the phone the other six are one tap behind the dropdown rather than in view.

The languages fact shows es and zh-Hans each serving their own title, their own audio file, and the expected first sentence, with audio_language matching. The screenshots show the whole page switching, not just the text: guide-es-desktop.png is titled 'Guia de recuperacion del implante coclear' with 'Idioma', 'TRANSCRIPCION', 'Reproducir', 'Velocidad', 'Subtitulos', 'LLAME PARA PEDIR AYUDA' and a Spanish chapter list, and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png is '人工耳蜗术后恢复指南' with 语言, 文字稿, 播放, 速度, 字幕 and a Mandarin chapter list. Even the label drawn into panel 4 is translated - 'Check for tape', 'Revise si hay cinta', '检查有没有胶布'. No stray English in either non-English page.

The provider_file fact records two steps, paste the block and copy the link, 18 ms from paste to link, no requests after load and zero account or login fields, so nothing is signed into and no app is installed. provider-filled.png shows the four columns read straight out of the pasted block - Antibiotic No, Pain medication Yes, Follow-up 10/01/2026, Language Espanol - each marked 'your block' in the From column and each still editable on the page, with a note that changing a value here rewrites the matching line in the block. provider-draft.png shows the same table before the *** placeholders are filled: each row says what it could not read and offers the choice, and Follow-up offers the preset 'Use "about two weeks"'. guide-from-link.png confirms the link carries the choices - Spanish page, and the transcript reads 'Su revision de la herida y examen del oido: 1 de octubre de 2026'. Two things for Song rather than for the build: an Antibiotic 'No' currently changes nothing the patient sees, because the guide has no wording yet for patients who get no antibiotic and the page says so plainly in provider-filled.png; and with a date set, chapter 3 still says the clinic will give you the date just above the line that gives it (guide-from-link.png).

The review_line fact shows one line in the block, 'Video guide: language {English/Spanish/Mandarin}    Reviewed by *** on ***', clinician_badge null and review_date_in_link false, and the link fragment '#a=0&p=1&f=2026-10-01&l=es' carries no review date. The page says the same thing to the provider in both states: 'Stays in your note. The patient's guide shows no reviewer line' in provider-draft.png, and 'Not shown to the patient, and not carried in the link. It stays in your note' next to the filled 'Dr. Example / 09/19/2026' in provider-filled.png. guide-from-link-badges.png, the transcript scrolled to the end of chapter 7, shows no reviewer line or badge, which is what the page promised.

The card_summary fact has the card on the first screen at both widths and the card itself returning 200. The link is on the first screen in every screenshot: top right at 1280x800 as 'Print the card', 'Imprimir la tarjeta', '打印卡片', and beside the speed control at 375x812 in guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png and guide-zh-Hans-phone.png. One tap, no scrolling, at both widths.
